public.title: Constant output
public.statement: No input. Output the single integer 6.

public.title: Echo
public.statement: Input: one integer x in 0..15. Output x.

public.title: Print twice
public.statement: Input: x in 0..15. Output x twice.

public.title: Keep the newest value
public.statement: Input: a, b, each in 0..15. Output only b.

public.title: Successor
public.statement: Input: x in 0..14. Output x + 1.

public.title: Reorder three values
public.statement: Input: three integers, each in 0..15. Output the values at input positions [3, 2, 1] in that order. Input positions are numbered from 1.

public.title: Add
public.statement: Input: a, b, each in 0..7. Output a + b.

public.title: Repeat a transformed value
public.statement: Input: n in 0..5, v in 0..10. Output v + 2, repeated n times.

public.title: Counting sequence
public.statement: Input: n in 0..8. Output n integers: 2, 2 + 1, ..., 2 + n - 1. Output nothing when n = 0.

public.title: Sum with offset
public.statement: Input: n in 0..5, followed by n integers each in 0..2. Output their sum + 0. For n = 0, output 0.

public.title: Equality indicator
public.statement: Input: x in 0..15. Output 1 if x equals 10, otherwise 0.

public.title: Scale and offset
public.statement: Input: x in 0..3. Output 2 * x + 2.

public.title: Echo and total
public.statement: Input: n in 0..5, followed by n integers each in 0..2. Output those n values in order, then their sum. For n = 0, output 0.

public.title: Count nonzero values
public.statement: Input: n in 0..5, followed by n integers each in 0..15. Output the number of nonzero values among those n integers.

public.title: Echo a stream
public.statement: Input: n in 0..5, followed by n integers each in 0..15. Output those n values in order. Output nothing when n = 0.

public.title: Select a value
public.statement: Input: x, a, b, each in 0..15. Output a if x = 0, otherwise b.

public.title: Sum of products
public.statement: Input: n in 0..3, followed by n pairs a, b, each value in 0..2. Output the sum of the n products a * b. For n = 0, output 0.

public.title: Sum successive pairs
public.statement: Input: n in 0..4, followed by n pairs a, b, each value in 0..7. Output the sum of each pair in order. Output nothing when n = 0.

public.title: Triangular number
public.statement: Input: n in 0..5. Output 1 + 2 + ... + n. For n = 0, output 0.

public.title: Running totals
public.statement: Input: n in 0..5, followed by n integers each in 0..2. Output their n successive prefix sums. Output nothing when n = 0.
